name: agent-trust-card
description: ATC/1.0 SDK v1.1.0 — issue, verify, and inspect Agent Trust Cards in any JavaScript runtime (Node.js >=18, Deno, Bun, browsers). Now with HTTP revocation list fetch (fetch_revocation option, 5s timeout). Framework-agnostic, zero external deps beyond `canonicalize` (RFC 8785 JCS). Includes CLI (`atc verify card.json`, `atc issue`, `atc inspect`), sync verifyATCSync() for non-async callers, async verifyATC() with optional revocation list fetch. Implements the ATC/1.0 specification (10 controls: ATC-001 Identity through ATC-010 Runtime Trust, 8 required + 2 optional) using Ed25519 (RFC 8032) signatures and RFC 8785 JCS canonical JSON. Maintained by AliceLabs LLC (Wyoming, USA, 2026).
